    3. Disclaimer

    1. For information only. The Site is an educational and artistic project. Its materials are not medical, psychological, psychotherapeutic, legal, financial or religious advice, services or recommendations. The Site is not an educational program and does not issue certificates of training.
    2. Practices (breathing, meditation, movement, yoga, qigong) are not treatment and do not replace the help of a doctor or psychotherapist. Do not do them without consulting a doctor if you have: pregnancy; heart or vascular disease, high blood pressure; epilepsy; respiratory disease; recent surgery or injury; mental disorders, including psychosis, bipolar disorder, severe depression, post-traumatic stress disorder. Stop the practice if you feel dizziness, pain, shortness of breath, fear or any other deterioration. Do not do the practices while driving, in water or anywhere a loss of attention is dangerous. The User does the practices voluntarily, assesses their own condition and bears responsibility for it.
    3. Photosensitivity. The Site contains flashes of light, flicker and rapid changes of images (especially in the Underside). People with photosensitive epilepsy or migraine should avoid these sections.
    4. Traditions and teachings are presented as testimonies of human experience and culture. This is not preaching, not a call to adopt or abandon any faith, not an evaluation of religions and not an attempt to offend anyone’s feelings. Resonances between the images of traditions and the discoveries of science are marked honestly: where there is a direct link and where only a likeness.
    5. Science. Scientific information is current as of the date of publication and marked by reliability: ● established, ◐ hypothesis or disputed, ○ tradition or image. Knowledge changes, and inaccuracies and errors are possible. Images of extinct creatures, ancient eras and bodies are artistic reconstructions.
    6. The User’s decisions. The User decides how to apply information from the Site and is responsible for their own decisions and their consequences. The Author is not responsible for the actions of third parties who use the Site or its materials, including in breach of these terms.
    7. Technical matters. The Site uses 3D graphics and may put a heavy load on your device. The Author is not responsible for interruptions, errors, incompatibility with particular devices and browsers, or the loss of journal entries and marks stored in the User’s browser. Links to third-party sites are given for convenience; the Author is not responsible for their content.

    1. The Site does not collect personal data. It has no registration, forms, comments, advertising, analytics or tracking cookies.
    2. Browser storage. The stations you have passed, journal entries, practice marks, your language choice and the fact that you accepted these terms are stored only in the browser on your device (localStorage). The Author does not receive or see them. You can erase them in My Astrolabe (the “Erase everything” button) or in your browser settings.
    3. Hosting. The Site is hosted by Vercel Inc. Like any web server, the host technically processes your IP address and browser information to deliver the page and may keep request logs under its own rules. The Author does not request these logs and does not use them to identify visitors. Fonts and libraries are loaded from the Site’s own server, not from third-party services. The version of the Site on claude.ai runs on Anthropic’s platform and is subject to its privacy policy.
    4. Letters. If you write to the Author, your address and the text of your letter are used only to reply and are not passed on to third parties.
    5. Changes. If the Site begins to collect any data (for example, a newsletter subscription), this policy will be supplemented in advance in accordance with Federal Law No. 152-FZ “On Personal Data”.

The 12+ mark has been set by the Author voluntarily under Federal Law No. 436-FZ “On the Protection of Children from Information Harmful to Their Health and Development”: the Site is not registered as a mass medium.
